name: io.github.ra1labsworkx-wq/snapback
title: Snapback
description: Diagnose why an AI agent failed and get the verified fix — instantly, free, no LLM. Catches loops, step/token/context limits, wrong output, and 46 families of infrastructure errors (payments, on-chain, Kubernetes, serverless, Redis, GraphQL, Stripe, Terraform, and more), returning the non-obvious fix a base model gets wrong. Gate it for autonomous self-heal. Pay-per-call via x402 (Solana/EVM) for metered tools; core diagnosis is free.
